title: NPS Notes
text:
This site holds the material students need from me rather than from a particular course: how I advise, what I expect from thesis work, and the technical how-tos I would otherwise explain one conversation at a time.
Course material lives on its own site — see ME 2801 — Introduction to Feedback Control.
